description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan Interest Pause API in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interest pause periods on loans, both by loan ID and external ID, as well as validation checks for overlapping periods and date constraints. The class extends a base integration test class and uses REST-assured for HTTP requests, leveraging helper classes to perform various loan operations.

classes.name: LoanInterestPauseApiTest
classes.description: Integration test class for the Loan Interest Pause API, testing creation, retrieval, update, delete operations, and validation scenarios for loans in the Apache Fineract system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up test environment, initializes request/response specifications, helper instances, and creates necessary entities like client, loan product, and loan before each test.

methods.name: createRequiredEntities
methods.description: Creates client, loan product, and loan entities required for the tests.

methods.name: createClientEntity
methods.description: Creates a default client and verifies its creation on the server.

methods.name: createLoanProductEntity
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specified parameters, including accounts and interest calculation details.

methods.name: createLoanEntity
methods.description: Creates, approves, and disburses a loan based on the created loan product and client.
